records.subject: Health
records.title: Health Personnel By Sex, Annual
records.footnote: Doctors refer to those on full, conditional and temporary (service) registration with valid Practising Certificate. Nurses refer to registered and enrolled nurses, as well as registered midwives. Data are used for SDG 3.c.1 'Health worker density and distribution'. Please refer to the Sustainable Development Goals (SDG) Global Metadata (https://unstats.un.org/sdgs/metadata) for more information on SDG 3.c.1.
